exercises.name: Front Squat
how_to: Rack the barbell across the front of your shoulders with elbows high.
Unrack, step back, and set feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down keeping the torso upright until thighs reach parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
how_to: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell vertically against your chest.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Squat down between your knees keeping the chest tall.
Push through your heels to return to standing.

exercises.name: Hack Squat (Machine)
how_to: Set your shoulders and back against the machine pads.
Place feet on the platform shoulder-width apart.
Release the safeties and lower until knees bend to about 90 degrees.
Press through your feet to extend the legs.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
how_to: Stand a couple feet in front of a bench facing away.
Place the top of your rear foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Drive through the front heel to return to the top.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunges
how_to: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees bend to 90 degrees.
Drive through the front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.

exercises.name: Forward Lunges
how_to: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step one foot forward and lower until the rear knee nears the floor.
Push off the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.

exercises.name: Leg Extension (Machine)
how_to: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Hook your shins behind the padded lever.
Extend your knees to straighten the legs fully.
Lower under control back to the start.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
how_to: Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Lean back and bend the knees, lowering the torso and hips together.
Contract the quads to return to standing.

exercises.name: Step-Ups
how_to: Stand facing a bench or box at about knee height.
Place one full foot on top of the surface.
Drive through that heel to step up and stand tall.
Step back down under control and repeat.

exercises.name: Box Squat
how_to: Set a box or bench behind you and rack the barbell on your upper back.
Unrack and stand just in front of the box.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the box.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

exercises.name: Zercher Squat
how_to: Hold the barbell cradled in the crooks of your elbows.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and chest tall.
Squat down keeping the elbows tucked and torso upright.
Drive up through your heels to stand.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
how_to: Stand with your back flat against a wall.
Slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep knees over ankles and hold the position.
Push back up the wall when finished.

exercises.name: Cyclist Squat (Heels Elevated)
how_to: Place your heels on a small plate or wedge.
Hold dumbbells at your sides or a single one at your chest.
Squat straight down keeping the torso upright.
Drive up through the balls of your feet to stand.

exercises.name: Split Squat (Static)
how_to: Stand in a staggered stance holding dumbbells at your sides.
Keep the front foot flat and the rear heel lifted.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is parallel.
Press through the front heel to rise; finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
how_to: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as you lower the bar.
Keep the bar close and back flat until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl (Machine)
how_to: Lie face down with your ankles under the padded lever.
Grip the handles and keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower under control back to the start.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
how_to: Kneel upright with your ankles anchored under a fixed support.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your torso toward the floor as slowly as possible.
Use your hands to catch and push back to the start.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
how_to: Position yourself in the GHD with feet secured against the plate.
Start with your body straight and horizontal.
Bend at the knees to raise your torso in an arc.
Lower back down under control to horizontal.

exercises.name: Good Mornings
how_to: Rack a barbell across your upper back and step out.
Set feet shoulder-width with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips, lowering your chest until your torso nears parallel.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
how_to: Hold a dumbbell and balance on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hip, extending the free leg straight behind you.
Lower the weight until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive the hip forward to return upright, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
how_to: Face away from a low cable with the rope between your legs.
Step forward and hinge at the hips holding the rope.
Push your hips back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Snap your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze the glutes.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
how_to: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor an arm's length ahead.
Hinge and hike the bell back between your legs.
Explosively drive your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back into the next hinge and repeat.

exercises.name: Stability Ball Hamstring Curl
how_to: Lie on your back with heels on a stability ball.
Lift your hips into a bridge position.
Curl the ball toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Roll it back out under control while keeping hips lifted.

exercises.name: Slider Leg Curl
how_to: Lie on your back with heels on sliders or towels.
Bridge your hips off the floor.
Extend your legs out by sliding the heels away.
Pull the heels back in while keeping hips elevated.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
how_to: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench.
Roll a padded barbell over your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
how_to: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Drive through your heels to raise your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top with a straight body line.
Lower your hips back to the floor under control.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
how_to: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat.
Extend the other leg straight out.
Drive through the planted heel to raise your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top, lower down, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Cable Kickback
how_to: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and cuff one ankle.
Face the machine and hold on for balance.
Kick that leg straight back squeezing the glute.
Return under control, finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Machine Hip Thrust
how_to: Sit in the machine with the pad across your hips.
Set your back against the support and feet flat.
Drive your hips up to extend fully.
Squeeze the glutes, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
how_to: Set feet wide with toes pointed out and the bar over midfoot.
Grip the bar inside your knees with a flat back.
Drive through your heels and push the floor away.
Stand tall locking the hips, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge
how_to: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other into a curtsy.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel.
Push back to standing and alternate sides.

exercises.name: Frog Pumps
how_to: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together.
Let your knees fall out to the sides.
Drive through your heels to thrust your hips up.
Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower down.

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Walk
how_to: Loop a band around your legs above the knees or ankles.
Sit into a quarter squat with tension on the band.
Step sideways keeping constant band tension.
Take several steps one way, then return the other way.

exercises.name: Clamshells
how_to: Lie on your side with a band around your thighs and knees bent.
Stack your hips and keep your feet together.
Raise your top knee like a clam opening.
Lower under control, finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Donkey Kicks
how_to: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keeping the knee bent, drive one foot up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching the low back.
Lower under control, finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrants
how_to: Start on all fours with a neutral spine.
Keeping the knee bent, raise one leg out to the side.
Lift until the thigh is near parallel to the floor.
Lower under control, finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Hip Abduction
how_to: Cuff one ankle to a low cable and stand side-on to the machine.
Hold the frame for balance.
Sweep the working leg out to the side away from the stack.
Return under control, finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Adductor Machine
how_to: Sit in the machine with your legs outside the pads.
Set the starting width to a comfortable stretch.
Squeeze your thighs together against the pads.
Return under control to the start.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
how_to: Lie on your side with your top foot resting on a bench.
Prop up on your forearm beneath your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold the position, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat
how_to: Stand with a wide stance and toes turned out.
Hold your weight at your chest or hanging between your legs.
Squat straight down keeping knees tracking over toes.
Drive through your heels to stand tall.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
how_to: Stand with a very wide stance and toes slightly out.
Shift your weight over one leg and squat down on that side.
Keep the other leg straight with the heel down.
Push back to center and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Wide-Stance Leg Press
how_to: Sit in the leg press with your back flat against the pad.
Place feet high and wide with toes turned out.
Release the safeties and lower the platform under control.
Press through your heels to extend without locking the knees.

exercises.name: Cable Adduction
how_to: Cuff the inside ankle to a low cable and stand side-on.
Start with the leg pulled out to the side.
Sweep the working leg across your body against the resistance.
Return under control, finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Adduction
how_to: Lie on your side with the bottom leg straight.
Cross the top leg in front and rest the foot on the floor.
Raise the bottom straight leg toward the ceiling.
Lower under control, finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Abductor Machine
how_to: Sit in the machine with your legs inside the pads.
Set your back against the support.
Push your thighs outward against the pads.
Return under control to the start.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
how_to: Position your shoulders under the pads and balls of feet on the platform.
Let your heels drop for a full stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower under control back to the stretch.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise (Machine)
how_to: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and pads on your thighs.
Release the safety and let your heels drop.
Press up onto your toes squeezing the calves.
Lower under control back to the stretch.

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raise
how_to: Place the balls of your feet on a raised surface and hinge at the hips.
Support your upper body on a bench or rail.
Let your heels drop for a stretch.
Press up onto your toes, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
how_to: Stand on one foot with the ball of the foot on an edge.
Hold a support for balance.
Let the heel drop below the step for a stretch.
Press up onto the toes, lower under control, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
how_to: Sit in the leg press with the balls of your feet low on the platform.
Extend your legs and release the safeties.
Push the platform away by pressing through your toes.
Let your toes flex back for a stretch under control.

exercises.name: Calf Raise On Step
how_to: Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of a step.
Hold a rail or wall for balance.
Let your heels drop below the step for a stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as possible, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Clean
how_to: Set up over the bar with a shoulder-width grip and flat back.
Pull the bar from the floor, extending the hips and knees explosively.
Shrug and pull under the bar, dropping into a front-rack squat.
Stand tall to complete the lift.

exercises.name: Power Clean
how_to: Set up over the bar with a shoulder-width grip and flat back.
Explosively extend the hips and knees to accelerate the bar.
Shrug and pull under, catching the bar in a partial squat.
Stand tall to finish.

exercises.name: Snatch
how_to: Set up with a wide grip and flat back over the bar.
Pull explosively, extending the hips and knees fully.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead in a deep squat.
Stand up to complete the lift.

exercises.name: Box Jumps
how_to: Stand facing a sturdy box a short distance away.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Explode up and jump onto the box, landing softly.
Stand tall, then step back down and reset.

exercises.name: Broad Jumps
how_to: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Explode forward, jumping out as far as possible.
Land softly with bent knees and reset.

exercises.name: Jump Squats
how_to: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat.
Explode straight up off the floor.
Land softly and immediately sink into the next rep.

exercises.name: Sled Push
how_to: Grip the sled uprights with arms extended and body leaning in.
Drive one leg back powerfully into the ground.
Take short, explosive strides to push the sled forward.
Maintain a low lean throughout the distance.

exercises.name: Sled Pull
how_to: Attach a strap or handles to a loaded sled.
Hold the handles with a flat back and lean away.
Drive through your legs to walk or pull backward.
Keep tension and reel the sled toward you steadily.

exercises.name: Jump Rope (Calf Endurance)
how_to: Hold the rope handles with the rope behind your heels.
Swing the rope overhead with your wrists.
Hop lightly on the balls of your feet as it passes under.
Keep a steady rhythm and stay tall.
